name: Decree No. 13/2023/ND-CP on Personal Data Protection
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by Government of Vietnam (chinhphu.vn) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within Government of Vietnam (chinhphu.vn).
